subject: Partner onboarding: service account provisioning and SCIM delta request
messages:
From: Marcy Lin <marcy@integralpartners.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 21 Jun 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Partner onboarding: service account provisioning + SCIM evidence request

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We're starting the security intake for the Integrations team and need a compact packet to satisfy our internal reviewers and the external SIG review. Can you share the following by EOD Wednesday if possible?

- Current inventory of service accounts used for the partner integration (names, roles, owners).
- SCIM delta/snapshot showing provisioning events for the last 30 days (sample CSV or JSON).
- RBAC mapping for the integration: which roles are granted to the connector and justification for any privileged scopes.
- Evidence of ephemeral credential rotation or key rotation policy applied to those accounts.

If you have a short readme explaining how the connector authenticates (SAML/OIDC flow, assertion audience, and any session TTLs) that would speed review. We're happy to redact sensitive IDs — send the file names and we'll request the right access.

Attaching our intake template would be helpful (I'll send separately). If we can't get everything by Wednesday, what's the minimum bundle that will unblock the SIG questionnaire?

Appreciate the help — looping Amanda from Integrations in case she wants to add anything.

Thanks,
Marcy Lin
Security Program Manager
Integral Partners

--
Attachment: intake_template_v2.docx (docx)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcy Lin <marcy@integralpartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 21 Jun 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Partner onboarding: service account provisioning + SCIM evidence request

Hi Marcy —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a minimal audit bundle that should satisfy the SIG intake and your reviewers:

1) Service account inventory (sanitized) — names, primary owner, roles granted, creation date. Draft attached: sa_inventory_draft.xlsx
2) SCIM delta snapshot for the last 30 days — sample JSON and CSV extract attached: scim_delta_sample.json (JSON) and scim_snapshot_20260620.csv (CSV).
3) RBAC mapping doc — brief mapping + rationales (will include notes on why connector needs each scope).
4) Rotation policy excerpt — we can provide our rotation policy snippet and a one-line confirmation of enforced rotation cadence.

What I'll need from you: are you OK with us redacting internal user IDs and replacing them with deterministic tokens? Also, do you want SAML assertion samples (with certs redacted) included, or would a short flow diagram be enough?

Target: I'll send the draft bundle by EOD Tuesday (our side) and a final sanitized ZIP by Wednesday morning if no redaction iterations are needed.

Attaching preliminary files for your review: sa_inventory_draft.xlsx, scim_delta_sample.json

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0132
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcy Lin <marcy@integralpartners.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 21 Jun 2026 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Partner onboarding: service account provisioning + SCIM evidence request

Hi all —

Looks good. Two quick clarifications from the security/product side:

- RBAC mapping: for any role that grants write/delete on customer resources we need a short justification tied to use-case (i.e., why the connector needs that write scope). Please mark those rows in the inventory with a required justification field.
- Ephemeral creds: we rotate connector keys quarterly by default; for higher-risk partners we rotate monthly. I'll attach the rotation policy excerpt we typically share — rotation_policy.md (attached).

Also — Mateo, when you share the SCIM deltas please include a sample of the audit log line that ties a provisioning event to an initiating actor (service account or human). That link is often the gating item for auditors.

Marcy — if your SIG reviewers will accept tokenized IDs and a summary mapping to production IDs under an NDA, confirm and we'll prepare that version.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: rotation_policy.md (md)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcy Lin <marcy@integralpartners.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 22 Jun 2026 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Partner onboarding: service account provisioning + SCIM evidence request

Marcy —

Confirming receipt of Mateo's drafts. I'll open JIRA-OPS-4123 to track the evidence handoff and tie it to HubSpot IP-2026-0492, so procurement and legal can see status.

Minimal unblock bundle (what we will post to your SFTP under the mutual NDA):
- sa_inventory_sanitized.xlsx (sanitized owners + justification column)
- scim_snapshot_20260620.csv (30-day provisioning events)
- rbac_mapping_summary.pdf (role->scope->justification)
- rotation_policy_excerpt.md (already attached)

If your team wants SAML assertion samples for the connector, please confirm and we'll redact certificate material and deliver a single example.

Thanks — we'll aim to publish the sanitized ZIP to the shared SFTP by Wednesday 17:00 UTC.
